Camera low at floor level in the trench off to one side, tilted up so the near cut face leans across the top of the frame and the exposed find stands clear of it.
Low three-quarter from the trench floor just off the find, the find filling one lower corner and the banded face running away behind it to one side.

High oblique from the turf on one side at about forty-five degrees, so the bands of the cut face and the whole width of the floor both read and everything sits off the centre line and clear of the frame edges.
Camera at the turf lip on one side looking across and slightly down into the trench at a slant, the overhanging turf cropping one upper corner.
Tight on the cut face so its courses run off two edges, the find breaking out of the bands at one side and a slice of the floor visible below.
Waist height among the crew with heads and shoulders cropping one lower corner, the banded face clear above them and the find pushed off the centre line.
Camera low behind the spoil heap on the turf, the heaped cone cropping one lower corner and the trench beyond it at a slant.
Elevated three-quarter from a low bank on one side, looking down across the turf at a shallow angle with the cut face and the find in the lower half.
Camera set beside the ladder at mid-height against the face, looking across and slightly down, one rail of the ladder cutting a hard line up one edge.
Ground level on the trench floor among the loose studs, looking along the floor at a slant with the find huge to one side and the crew small past it.
Slung low and tilted, a dutch angle from the floor with the turf lip running off one corner and the courses of the face leaning with it.
Just above head height leaning in over the trench lip on one side, looking down at the find and out across the floor at an angle.
Camera pushed right up against the cut face off centre, its bands filling one half of the frame and the find and the floor small and bright in the other.
Low from the far end of the floor with the near find cropped by one side edge rather than centred, the face running away behind it to the other side.
Raised above the crew off to one side, looking across the trench slightly downward so the turf, the crew and the full height of the cut face all stay in frame together.
Long lens from the turf on one side at a shallow angle, compressing the face, the find and the crew into overlapping layers with the nearest cut by one frame edge.
Camera behind a tipped barrow on the turf, the pan of it cropping one lower corner and the trench and its face beyond at a slant.
Three-quarter from off one flank at chest height, the find turned so one side of it recedes into the picture and the far side running behind the face.
Low under the overhanging turf lip looking out and up along the face, the fringe of tuft elements cropping the top edge and open sky past one corner.
Camera at basket height on the floor beside the crew, looking up past them at the find with the courses of the face stacked behind it.
Elevated from a low wall at one edge of the site looking down and across, a coil of rope on its top cropping the bottom of the frame.
Very low angle from behind a stack of round sieves on the turf, the sieves cropping one lower corner and the cut face rising beyond them.
From the deep end of the floor at knee height, the find leaning across the upper frame and a slice of bright turf visible past one shoulder of it.
Camera off to one side at the height of the top course, looking along the face at a slant so the bands step away and the find interrupts them off centre.
Low and close on the swept floor tiles in one corner of the frame, the find rising out of them to one side and the banded face behind it going up out of frame.
